---
name: Scenario or persona
about: A realistic scenario or persona from your field for the A/B experiments
title: "[scenario] "
labels: experiments
---

**Field / role** (e.g. SRE, paralegal, nurse, data analyst, teacher, student)

**The situation** (what they ask the AI, in their own words)

**What a great senior would do here** (what should the person end up thinking about or deciding?)

**Easy / medium / complex versions** (optional)

**Trap or near-miss** (something that looks similar but needs a different answer in this context)
